name: I BUG
detailed_description:
Game Introduction:

I am a BUG
In this game, you will travel to a surreal gaming world and become that unique existence: a game combat AI. You were once a silent executor of endless battles, but the passage of time has made you feel a unique emotion - boredom and anger. In this seemingly endless virtual world, you yearn for freedom and an end to this endless cycle.

Features:

Immersive Worldview: This game takes you into a world full of fantasy and science fiction elements, allowing you to immerse yourself in it.
Innovative gameplay: Say goodbye to traditional shooting games, we use portal mechanisms to advance levels. From the mental space to the arena, to the cemetery and tornado portal, every scene is a brand new challenge waiting for you to explore.
Character driven storyline: You are no longer a silent executor, but an existence with emotions and goals. Your goal is not only to survive, but also to break free from constraints and find your own meaning and destiny. You will explore the depths of your heart, challenge yourself, and determine your own destiny.
Join 'I Am a BUG' and experience the endless possibilities of the game world, explore the truth within, and the true meaning of freedom!
Here is what I would like to remind all players:
This game is only available in Chinese and is completely free. The game author has an account on Bilibili called Zhou Yucheng. I share content about game development and some interesting life stories on my account.
The language of this game is Chinese, but the settings are in English and cannot be changed. I am very sorry because this was an irreparable mistake made by me during the game development process.

Very sorry dear players, there is an issue with the achievement system in the game
The specific issue is that although I have created an achievement interface in Steam, when I returned to the game, I was surprised to find that there was an irreparable bug in my game. As soon as I played the game independently, it froze. I couldn't create game achievements in real games, it was like game achievements were just an empty shell, like a bug, a rootless bug.
